Match the following organic amendments with their descriptions.
1. Animal manure             a. Consists of decomposed plant and animal waste, which improves soil
organic matter and microbial activity
2. Compost                       b. Freshly grown crops that are incorporated into the soil to improve fertility
and nutrient availability
3. Crop residue                c. Animal-derived waste such as dung and urine, which provides essential
nutrients for soil and crops
4. Green manure crops    d. Remains of harvested crops that can be incorporated into the soil to enhance
organic matter content
